career.experience_intro: Over four years on the same eShop, from MasMovil to Orange: from the backend to the frontend and the platform in production.

experiences.title: Senior Frontend Developer
experiences.description: Platform that generates the eShops of 11 brands. I built a proxy generator (Helm + Nginx) for hundreds of redirects and reverse proxies between microfrontends, and I take part in Istio routing, the migration from SSR to PPR with Cache Components, and Core Web Vitals tracking on every release.

experiences.title: Software Engineer
experiences.description: Consultant for MasMovil: built from scratch in Next.js the multi-brand platform for Euskaltel, Telecable, R, Guuk, Racctel, MasMovil, Yoigo, Lyca and Lebara, in an Nx monorepo. I took part in most production releases with no lost sales or downtime, and the client later hired me.

about.title: Iván Ciudad Espinar - About Me
about.description: Who Iván Ciudad Espinar is away from code: how he started programming, video games, role-playing, LEGO, hardware and his favourite series and films.
about.image_alt: Iván Ciudad Espinar posing in Japan with the Golden Kinkaku-ji Temple in the background
about.heading_after: , and this is what my CV leaves out.
about.origin: **My start as a programmer** goes back to high school: in IT class we were challenged to build a small video game. That spark led me to my first real application, a grade calculator. Seeing that code could actually be useful is what got me hooked.
about.origin_short: **My start as a programmer** goes back to high school, with a small class video game and my first real app: a grade calculator.
about.work: **At work** I'm communicative and proactive. I adapt quickly to new projects, I dare to take on what nobody has mastered yet, and I'm often the person colleagues come to with questions. I enjoy sharing what I know so the team can grow.
about.work_short: **At work** I adapt quickly, I dare to try new things and I enjoy helping the team grow.
about.japan_alt: Iván Ciudad Espinar in Kyoto, with the golden Kinkaku-ji temple in the background
about.passions_p1: **Video games** are one of my great passions. I chose not to make them for a living so they would stay my space to unwind.
about.passions_p2: My favourite way to switch off is a table full of friends: **board games** and long **Dungeons & Dragons** campaigns. To balance it out, walking and the gym.
about.passions_short: **Video games** are how I unwind, which is why I chose not to make them for a living. And nothing beats a table with friends: **board games** and **D&D** campaigns.
about.dice_alt: Bowl of role-playing dice and board games
about.build_p1: My curiosity about how things work extends to **hardware**: I build my own computers from parts, clean them, measure voltages and push them with overclocking.
about.build_p2: My favourite pastime is building **LEGO** sets, especially Star Wars ones. I love structures so much that I once seriously considered studying architecture.
about.build_short: I build my PCs from parts and push them with overclocking. And I love **LEGO** sets: I nearly studied architecture out of my love for structures.
about.lego_alt: LEGO figures of Grogu, R2-D2 and C-3PO
